newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy regional court overturns Refco suspension.
newsitem.headline: Italy regional court overturns Refco suspension.

text.p: The regional court of Lazio has overturned the decision of stock market authority Consob to suspend Italian licenced broker Refco Italia Sim, after an appeal against the ruling by the brokerage house.
Consob ruled on August 30 to suspend the broker, in which Refco Inc of the U.S. has a 50 percent stake, for 60 days for a series of violations.
The decision of the court, which covers the region around Rome where Consob has its headquarters, was announced by Andrea Carboni, a board member of Refco Italia Sim.
